topic: Reserving a Big Birthday Table over the Phone

script.title: THE BIRTHDAY TABLE
script.story_hook: Ten guests, one cake, and a Saturday night mission.
script.intro_zh: 十位客人、一顆蛋糕，一場週六晚間的訂位任務。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to tonight's big phone call. Listen for booking a table with kids.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今晚這通重要的電話。留意帶著孩子訂位的說法。
script.outro: And that's a birthday booked, cake and all. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一場生日宴，連蛋糕一起訂定了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: The cake gets its own chair
script.char_a_description: a busy mother in her mid thirties with dark red hair in a messy knot, round earrings, an olive green field jacket, a smartwatch, and a sturdy build
script.char_b_description: a tidy man in his early thirties with a shaved black head, a gold pen behind his ear, a charcoal vest over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, and a neat square build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book a table for ten, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈteɪbəl fɚ tɛn pliz/
dialogue.zh: 您好，我想預約一張十人的桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. For what day and time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ θɪŋ fɚ wət deɪ ænd taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好的，請問是哪天、幾點？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This Saturday, around six thirty, if possible.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈsæɾɚdeɪ əˈɹaʊnd ˈsɪks ˈθɝɾi ɪf ˈpɑsəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 這週六，六點半左右，如果還有位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... Saturday is our loud night.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ˈsæɾɚdeɪ ɪz aʊɚ laʊd naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……週六晚上我們很熱鬧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud is fine, we're celebrating a sixth birthday.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ɪz faɪn wɪɹ ˈsɛləˌbɹeɪɾɪŋ ə sɪksθ ˈbɝθdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 熱鬧沒關係，我們要慶祝六歲的生日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, six! The hardest age to plan for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ sɪks ðə ˈhɑɹdɪst eɪdʒ tə plæn fɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，六歲！是最難規劃的年齡呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me about it. Ten guests, one very excited one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt tɛn ɡɛsts wʌn ˈvɛɹi ɪkˈsaɪɾɪd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 可不是嗎。十位客人，其中一位特別興奮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have a corner table, seats nine, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈkɔɹnɚ ˈteɪbəl sits naɪn ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我有一張角落桌，不過只能坐九位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine for ten people... that's math we failed.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn fɚ tɛn ˈpipəl ðæts mæθ wi feɪld/
dialogue.zh: 九個位子坐十個人……這數學我們不合格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or, I can push two tables together for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɹ aɪ kən pʊʃ tu ˈteɪbəlz təˈɡɛðɚ fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 或者，我可以幫您把兩張桌拼起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works! As long as the kids sit together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɝks æz lɔŋ æz ðə kɪdz sɪt təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！只要小孩們坐在一起就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, kid side first. Any high chairs needed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾɪd kɪd saɪd fɝst ˈɛni haɪ tʃɪɚz ˈnidɪd/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，兒童優先。需要寶寶椅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two, if you have them. Twins, total chaos.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɪf ju hæv ðɛm twɪnz ˈtoʊɾəl ˈkeɪɑs/
dialogue.zh: 有的話要兩張。雙胞胎嘛，完全失控。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have three high chairs, take a spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv θɹi haɪ tʃɪɚz teɪk ə spɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我們有三張寶寶椅，多一張給您備用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're speaking my language now, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ˈspikɪŋ maɪ ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ naʊ fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 你這句話說到我心坎裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I have twins too, so I get it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ hæv twɪnz tu soʊ aɪ ɡɛt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我也有雙胞胎，所以我懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now the big question, can we bring a cake?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt naʊ ðə bɪɡ ˈkwɛstʃən kæn wi brɪŋ ə keɪk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。再來是大問題：可以自己帶蛋糕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it, and we'll keep it on ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ ɪt ænd wil kip ɪt ɑn aɪs/
dialogue.zh: 帶來吧，我們會幫您冰著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are officially my favorite human being.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑɹ əˈfɪʃəli maɪ ˈfɛvɚɪt ˈhjumən biɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 您正式成為我最喜歡的人類。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, I'll put that on my name tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛɹfəl aɪl pʊt ðæt ɑn maɪ neɪm tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 別這樣，我會把這句話貼在我的名牌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do it! Marco, the cake guardian, love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɪt ˈmɑɹkoʊ ðə keɪk ˈɡɑɹdiən lʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 快貼！蛋糕守護者 Marco，太喜歡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already did, mentally. Now, about a deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈɹɛdi dɪd ˈmɛnɾəli naʊ əˈbaʊt ə dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 心裡已經貼了。現在，談談訂金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A deposit? For a birthday pasta night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɪˈpɑzɪt fɚ ə ˈbɝθdeɪ ˈpɑstə naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 訂金？不過是生日吃麵之夜耶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small ones cover us when no one shows up.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑl wʌnz ˈkʌvɚz ʌs wɛn noʊ wʌn ʃoʊz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 十人桌擺好了卻沒人來，訂金能補回損失。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oof, fair. How much are we talking about?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊf fɛɹ haʊ mʌtʃ ɑɹ wi ˈtɔkɪŋ əˈbaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，有道理。金額大概是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty dollars, back on your card that night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈdɑləɚz bæk ɑn jɔɹ kɑɹd ðæt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 二十元，當天餐後原路退回您的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, no problem at all, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn noʊ ˈpɑbləm æt ɔl ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，真的，完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, that was easy. Nobody ever agrees fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðæt wəz ˈizi ˈnoʊbədi ˈɛvəɹ əˈɡɹiz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 哇，太順利了，沒人會答應這麼快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I learned from renting a bounce house once.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɝnd fɚm ˈɹɛnɾɪŋ ə baʊns haʊs wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 我租過一次充氣城堡，學到教訓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't. My cousin still hears squeaking in dreams.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt maɪ ˈkʌzən stɪl hɪɚz ˈskwikɪŋ ɪn dɹimz/
dialogue.zh: 別說了，我表哥至今夢裡還有吱吱聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Okay, back to the serious birthday business.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ oʊkeɪ bæk tə ðə ˈsɪɹiəs ˈbɝθdeɪ ˈbɪznəs/
dialogue.zh: 哈！好，回到正經的生日事務。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the candles — when do we sing?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈkændəlz wɛn du wi sɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，蠟燭——我們幾點唱生日歌？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven fifteen, after the food, before cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈfɪftin ˈæftɚ ðə fud bɪˈfɔɹ keɪk/
dialogue.zh: 七點十五，上完餐點之後、蛋糕之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tell the kitchen, they love singing duties.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛl ðə ˈkɪtʃən ðeɪ lʌv ˈsɪŋɪŋ ˈdutiz/
dialogue.zh: 我會告訴廚房，他們最愛唱生日歌的任務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One request: can the cake sit by the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɹɪˈkwɛst kæn ðə keɪk sɪt baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有個請求：蛋糕可以安放在窗邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a six-year-old, the cake gets its own chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ə sɪks ˈjɪɹoʊld ðə keɪk ɡɛts ɪts oʊn tʃɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 為了六歲壽星，蛋糕當然有專屬座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! That's the whole magic of six, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts ðə hoʊl ˈmædʒɪk ʌv sɪks ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 對！老實說，這就是六歲的魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any allergies I should pass to the chef?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈælɚdʒi aɪ ʃʊd pæs tə ðə ʃɛf/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有過敏要轉告廚師？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One nut ban, and a gluten-free roll request.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn nʌt bæn ænd ə ˈɡlutən fri roʊl ɹɪˈkwɛst/
dialogue.zh: 一位不能吃堅果，還要一份無麩質麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted twice. Drinks pre-ordered or at the table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾɪd twaɪs dɹɪŋks pri ˈɔɹdɚd ɔɹ æt ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 記兩遍了。飲料是先點還是現場點？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At the table, kids change minds every minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə ˈteɪbəl kɪdz tʃeɪndʒ maɪndz ˈɛvɹi ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現場點吧，小孩一分鐘換一個主意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, so true it hurts. Anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ soʊ tɹu ɪt hɝts ˈɛnɪ θɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 哈，真實到心痛。還有別的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually yes — can we hang a banner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli jɛs kæn wi hæŋ ə ˈbænɚ/
dialogue.zh: 其實可以——我們能掛一條布條嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the wall, not the booth; use our tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə wɑl nɑt ðə butʰ juz aʊɚ teɪp/
dialogue.zh: 可以掛牆上，別貼卡座，只用我們的膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. You're more flexible than my mother-in-law.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil jʊɹ mɔɹ ˈflɛksəbəl ðæn maɪ ˈmʌðɚɪnlɔ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。您比我婆婆還通情達理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll take that as a badge of honor.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ðæt æz ə bædʒ ʌv ˈɑnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我就把這當成最高榮譽啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last thing: is parking a nightmare at six?
dialogue.phonetic: /læst θɪŋ ɪz ˈpɑɹkɪŋ ə ˈnaɪtmɛɹ æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事：六點停車是惡夢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One free lot behind us, three tight spots.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fri lɑt bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs θɹi taɪt spɑts/
dialogue.zh: 後面有一個免費停車場，另有三個路邊位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We fit two minivans, so that helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi fɪt tu ˈmɪnɪvænz soʊ ðæt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 我們開兩台大車來，這樣就有救。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text you a confirmation in ten minutes, ok?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ju ə ˌkɑnfɚˈmeɪʃən ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts oʊkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我十分鐘內傳簡訊跟您確認，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. And put the name Maya's party, big M.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ænd pʊt ðə neɪm ˈmɑjəz ˈpɑɹti bɪɡ ɛm/
dialogue.zh: 拜託。名字寫 Maya 的派對，大寫 M。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: M for Maya, M for Marco on duty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛm fɚ ˈmɑjə ɛm fɚ ˈmɑɹkoʊ ɑn ˈduti/
dialogue.zh: M 是 Maya，也是值班的 Marco。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salute, guardian. The cake is in good hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /səˈlut ˈɡɑɹdiən ðə keɪk ɪz ɪn ɡʊd hænz/
dialogue.zh: 向你敬禮，守護者。蛋糕交對人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six candles, one countdown, we'll be loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈkændəlz wʌn ˈkaʊntdaʊn wil bi laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 六根蠟燭、一次倒數，我們會超大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud is exactly the birthday theme this year.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli ðə ˈbɝθdeɪ θim ðɪs jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 吵鬧正是今年的生日主題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bring your loudest voice for the song.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn bɹɪŋ jɔɹ ˈlaʊdəst vɔɪs fɚ ðə sɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那就把最大的聲音帶來唱生日歌吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Thank you, Marco, seriously, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn θæŋk ju ˈmɑɹkoʊ ˈsɪɹiəs θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 說定了。謝謝你，Marco，真的，很謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to help a future six-year-old legend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə hɛlp ə ˈfjuːtʃɚ sɪks ˈjɪɹoʊld ˈlɛdʒənd/
dialogue.zh: 幫未來的傳奇六歲壽星，是我的榮幸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday at six thirty. We'll be the happy noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsæɾɚdeɪ æt ˈsɪks ˈθɝɾi wil bi ðə ˈhæpi nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 週六六點半，我們會是最快樂的那陣吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can't wait, tell Maya her cake has a seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /kænt weɪt tɛl ˈmɑjə hɚ keɪk hæz ə sit/
dialogue.zh: 等不及了，告訴 Maya 她的蛋糕有位子了。

script.youtube_title_en: "The Cake Gets Its Own Chair" — Booking a Big Birthday Table by Phone
script.youtube_description:
「蛋糕也有專屬座位」——想為六歲壽星訂一張十人桌，電話裡該說清哪些事？寶寶椅、拼桌、訂金、蛋糕放冰塊，全在這一通電話裡。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在餐廳的訂位台前。

你會聽到：預約十人桌與時間的開場句；拼桌、寶寶椅、掛布條的細節要求；十人沒來時訂金怎麼算、怎麼退；還有蛋糕寄存冰鎮、七點十五唱生日歌這種壽星專屬安排。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人打電話時的自然語感：um、ha、oof、wow、honestly。聽完你就會用：I'd like to book...、can we bring a cake、text me a confirmation。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The cake gets its own chair" — you want one big birthday table for a six-year-old and nine guests, and everything must be said clearly on one phone call. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the restaurant host stand.

You will hear: opening lines for booking a table for ten; asking to push tables together, for high chairs and a banner; the small deposit that protects the restaurant when ten plates show no one; plus cake on ice and a seven fifteen birthday song.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the phone rhythm Americans use daily: um, ha, oof, wow, honestly. By the end you'll own phrases like I'd like to book..., can we bring a cake, and text me a confirmation.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
孩子的六歲生日要到了，餐廳的電話你撥得出去嗎？十個人、兩台車、一顆蛋糕，對方會怎麼安排？聽說訂了桌卻沒來，還要收錢，是真的嗎？

這一集帶大家站在餐廳訂位台前，從預約十人桌、拼桌、要寶寶椅，一路談到訂金、蛋糕冰藏與唱生日歌的時間，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🎂 開場訂位：Hi, I'd like to book a table for ten, please.
🪑 細節要求：Two, if you have them. Twins, total chaos.
💳 訂金談法：A deposit? For a birthday pasta night?
🕯️ 蛋糕安排：One request: can the cake sit by the window?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、ha、oof、wow 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這通電話走一趟，下次要訂位，話就自己從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你的下一個生日，蛋糕永遠有最好的座位。
